entities.name: Bretagard
entities.description: One of the ten realms of Kaldheim, the realm of the humans, a single continent ringed by a stormy sea.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: The plane of ten realms to which Bretagard belongs.

entities.name: Feltmark
entities.description: A large plain of rolling grasslands, home to the Beskir clan.

entities.name: Aldergard Forest
entities.description: An ancient forest home to the nomadic Kannah and, in its Mire, the Skelle.

entities.name: Beskir
entities.description: A human clan of lawspeaker clerics who enforce the Code of Clans.

entities.name: Omenseekers
entities.description: A human clan of legendary explorers and navigators who control the sea.

entities.name: Vedrune
entities.description: An elite group of Omenseeker wizards who divine the future and navigate to other realms.

entities.name: Skelle
entities.description: A human clan of raiders who have broken the Code of Clans and follow the demon Varragoth.

entities.name: Tuskeri
entities.description: A human clan devoted to epic feats and boasting.

entities.name: Kannah
entities.description: A human clan cursed by the Einir to be eternal nomads in the Aldergard forest.

entities.name: Code of Clans
entities.description: The code through which Bretagard's five clans keep the peace.

entities.name: Maja
entities.description: A leader of the Beskir.

entities.name: Sigrid
entities.description: A leader of the Beskir.

entities.name: Hurrik
entities.description: Founder of the Beskir who once saved the god Alrund's life.

entities.name: Alrund
entities.description: A god whose life Hurrik once saved.

entities.name: Inga Rune-Eyes
entities.description: Leader of the Omenseekers.

entities.name: Varragoth
entities.description: A demon who escaped from Immersturm and tutored the Skelle; inflicted the Bloodsky massacre.

entities.name: Immersturm
entities.description: The realm from which Varragoth escaped.

entities.name: Arni Brokenbrow
entities.description: The current leader of the Tuskeri.

entities.name: Fynn the Snakehunter
entities.description: Leader of the Kannah and the only human who has ever wounded the Cosmos Serpent.

entities.name: Cosmos Serpent
entities.description: A great serpent that Fynn the Snakehunter managed to wound.

entities.name: Einir
entities.description: Those who cursed the Kannah to be eternal nomads.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: The warrior's paradise the Kannah seek.

entities.name: Bloodsky
entities.description: The name of Bretagard's winter season, commemorating the massacre by Varragoth and the Skelle.

events.summary: Varragoth and the Skelle carry out a horrific massacre, remembered in naming the winter season Bloodsky.
events.quote: a somber name that commemorates the horrific massacre inflicted by Varragoth and the Skelle

events.summary: Hurrik, founder of the Beskir, once saves the god Alrund's life.
events.quote: Their founder, Hurrik, once saved the god Alrund 's life.

events.summary: The Skelle grow into a terrible force under Varragoth's tutelage and break the Code of the Clans.
events.quote: They have broken the Code of the Clans and are no longer bound by it.

events.summary: The Kannah are cursed by the Einir to be eternal nomads in the Aldergard forest.
events.quote: Cursed by the Einir to be eternal nomads in the Aldergard forest

relations.quote: Bretagard is one of the ten realms of the plane of Kaldheim .
The Beskir ( 9 cards ) are led by two women: Maja and Sigrid .
The Beskir ( 9 cards ) are led by two women: Maja and Sigrid .
Their founder, Hurrik, once saved the god Alrund 's life.
The Omenseekers are led by Inga Rune-Eyes .

relations.note: the Skelle rose under his tutelage
relations.quote: The Skelle clan became the terrible force it is today under the tutelage of Varragoth
The current leader of the Tuskeri clan is Arni Brokenbrow .
The Kannah are led by Fynn the Snakehunter
